name: floot
description: Connect Floot to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Floot MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Floot to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with build and edit web apps using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Floot workspace.
Find anything in Floot that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review build and edit web apps in Floot.
